summary: @onereach/si-root 0.9.6 preinstall fetches Bun runtime and executes obfuscated payload
details: Version 0.9.6 of @onereach/si-root ships a preinstall lifecycle hook (`node setup.mjs`) that downloads the Bun runtime binary from github.com/oven-sh/bun releases (v1.3.13), unpacks it to a temp directory, chmods it executable, and invokes it against a sibling file `math_init.js` — a 727KB heavily obfuscated (`// @bun @bun-cjs` header, obfuscator.io-style shuffled string array with rotate function and String.fromCodePoint decoder) bundle. The package's declared purpose is a Vue input component library and has no legitimate need to fetch an alternate JavaScript runtime and execute an opaque compiled bundle at install. Additionally, `package.json` declares `"files": ["lib/*"]`, but `setup.mjs` and `math_init.js` are shipped at the tarball root outside that allowlist and the preinstall hook is added — a manifest/tarball mismatch consistent with malicious re-publication of a previously legitimate package. Executing the payload under Bun rather than Node also evades Node-based install-time inspection. This is an install-time alternate-runtime dropper executing attacker-controlled obfuscated code on the installer's machine.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
